cohort: The study included 6125 mothers of children aged 12-23 months across all 34 provinces of Afghanistan.
finding: Nationally, 51% of children aged 12-23 months received all recommended routine immunizations, while 31% were partially vaccinated, with common reasons for partial vaccination including distance, lack of awareness, lack of faith, maternal busyness, and fear of side effects.
cross-section timing: Children were aged 12-23 months at the time of the survey.
